distinct_from.capability: connect an outside service with its login or key and keep the secret sealed so no tool can read it back: it is placed into an outgoing request only at send time and any echo of it is replaced in the reply
distinct_from.why: The owner seals and connects services; this function only composes existing service and computer-place descriptors into one read-only list.
Tests consume the list composer rather than implement it.

preserve: Read only descriptor rows and supplied discovery answers
Never expose a secret field value
Categories and available services and places remain data
allowed_deltas: Combine the two existing row owners in one response
banned_substitutions: Connecting a service or scanning a computer while listing
Embedding service and place catalogues in code

capability_rows.capability: write from a recipe: compose the exact instruction, gate what was written before it goes on, and run the person's content actions and instruction blocks
compose unit-safe measurement, forecast and billing records into saved account lists and a generic runtime-authored screen
find a person's files by words, name, place, kind or spoken words in the index their computer already keeps
see which places on this computer Trillion can read (folders, notes, recordings, messages, mail, photos, drives, AI apps), and bring in what is new in each, every place a row
send a connection's requests from my own computer instead of a server when the service refuses a server's address
copy or move files between the drives on a person's computer, pause or stop that work, find every place a file is, and eject a drive
write a post, check it for each place it goes, approve it as reviewed and set it to go at its time
bring a person's conversations from every app (chat apps, email, AI chats) into one place to read and reply
read the instruction, command, skill and MCP-server files the person keeps for their other AI apps, in place and labelled by app
let an account choose among places to keep a list from its own place rows and the default places others published
